keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Ricardo Chávez (Monterrey) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Érick Sánchez (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Monterrey 0, Club América 0.
Substitution, Club América. Brian Rodríguez replaces Érick Sánchez.
Substitution, Monterrey. Fidel Ambríz replaces Luca Orellano.
Óscar Perea (Club América) is shown the yellow card.
Edwin Cerrillo (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club América. Isaías Violante replaces Óscar Perea.
Substitution, Club América. Cristián Borja replaces Santiago Bueno.
Alan Cervantes (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club América. Carlos Álvarez replaces Álex Zendejas.
Substitution, Monterrey. Luis Reyes replaces Jesús Corona.
Delay in match because of an injury Hugo Cuypers (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Monterrey. Cristian Reyes replaces Hugo Cuypers because of an injury.
Substitution, Monterrey. César Garza replaces Óliver Torres.
Israel Reyes (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Carlos Álvarez (Club América) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Israel Reyes (Club América).
Delay in match because of an injury Fidel Ambríz (Monterrey).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Monterrey 0, Club América 0.
